5 signs a task should be automated:
It repeats weekly. Same rules each time. Copy-paste between apps. It starts with an event. Low risk if it goes wrong.
Score each task out of 5. 3 or more? Automate it. Just one, this week.
Anything involving money or customers gets a human approval step.

What scored highest? Comment your task below and I might automate it in the next episode.
Small business? DM me AUDIT.
